correctness.rationale: For independent uniform-parent growth, L_{n+1}=L_n+1-J_n and P_{n+1}=P_n+D_n+1. Conditioning gives E(D|T_n)=P_n/n, E(J|T_n)=L_n/n, E(JD|T_n)=Q_n/n; mixed old-tree contributions cancel, so c_{n+1}=c_n-q_n/n+ell_n p_n/n². The leaf-depth update Q_{n+1}=Q_n+(1-J)D+1 yields q_{n+1}=(1−1/n)q_n+H_n and q_n=n H_{n-1}/2−(n−2)/4. With ell_n=n/2 and p_n=nH_{n-1}−(n−1), covariance decrement is exactly −1/4, from c_2=0. Classical Var(L_n)=n/12 for n>=3 gives the regression slope and asymptotic Var(P_n) coefficient gives n^-1/2 correlation. Fresh exhaustive rational enumeration of all (n−1)! recursive trees for every n=2..10, total 409113, verified covariance, q_n and marginal moments.
